title: PiMRef: Deducing Ever-evolving Spear-phishing Emails with Knowledge Base Invariants
abstract: arXiv:2507.15393v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Phishing email is a critical step in the cybercrime kill chain due to the high reachability of victims' email accounts and the low cost of launching phishing campaigns. This ever-evolving nature of phishing emails makes traditional rule-based and feature-engineering-based phishing email detectors fight an uphill battle in the cat-and-mouse game of defense and attack.   In this work, we show that, large language models (LLMs) can be effectively exploited to generate profile-grounded spear-phishing, compromising major paradigms of phishing email detectors. To defend against such LLM-based spear-phishing attacks, we propose PiMRef, the first reference-based solution to detect ever-evolving phishing emails using knowledge-based invariants, targeting the identity-impersonation attacks that characterize spear-phishing. translated_abstract: 钓鱼邮件是网络犯罪杀伤链中的关键一环，这是因为攻击者能够高度触达受害者的电子邮件账户，且发起钓鱼活动的成本极低。钓鱼邮件不断演变的特性，使得传统的基于规则和基于特征工程的钓鱼邮件检测器在攻防“猫鼠游戏”中始终处于被动局面。在本研究中，我们展示了大型语言模型（LLM）可以被有效利用来生成基于个人画像的鱼叉式钓鱼邮件，从而攻破主流的钓鱼邮件检测范式。为了防御此类基于LLM的鱼叉式钓鱼攻击，我们提出了PiMRef——首个基于参考的解决方案，利用基于知识的不变量来检测不断演变的钓鱼邮件，专门针对以鱼叉式钓鱼为特征的身份冒充攻击。我们的核心依据在于：具有说服力的钓鱼邮件通常包含“可证伪的声明”，这些声明与……
tldr: 该论文提出PiMRef——首个利用知识库不变量检测不断演变的鱼叉式钓鱼邮件的参考比对式解决方案，以应对大语言模型生成的身份冒充类钓鱼攻击。
